profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Brainshark/Bigtincan
profile.summary:
Hands-on technical software development principal working on the Microsoft Platforms Windows and Azure.

Recent focus working on the Brainshark Platform:

 • AI integration of : Text To Speech, Speech To Text, Captioning, Translation, summarization, Avatar video generation, AI generated questions.

 • Azure Media System (AMS) replacement with Ravnur (Video conversion and streaming), study as well HLS conversion with independent and free solutions.

• Support of 2 GB SCORM Zip file and 4 GB video files

 • In charge of the back-end automation suite development.
 
 • Improve team efficiency, spread knowledge among developers, testers and product personal.

 • On premise and/or in the cloud development (Windows, Azure).

 • Transitioning from .NET Framework to .NET Core.

Management:

I generally lead a team of 4 to 10 people composed of developers, testers and DevOps.

Occasionally I speak at different code camps and user groups in Massachusetts about programming in Python, JavaScript, C# on Windows or iOS or about hardware for .NET.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Focusing on the Brainshark Platform maintenance and evolution 70% Azure, 30% Windows.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.locationName: Providence County, Rhode Island, United States
positions.description:
As a full stack developer on the eMoneyAdvisor wealth management platform (SAS), I am involved in the
    ● Rewrite of one of the main web UI feature in Javascript with React, Redux and Jest
    ● Rewrite of backend legacy code using C#,  ASP.NET Core API and Swagger
    ● Improve JavaScript unit test tools and mentor other developers
    ● Participate in the build and deployment process with Jenkins and bitbucket

positions.title: Team Lead
positions.description:
RES Software was acquired by IVANTI in the summer of 2017.

Team lead of the RES Service Store for Azure

• Develop the first 2 POCs to port the RES Service Store from Windows on premise to Azure as SAS architecture
• Manage a team of 2 developers, 2 QA and 1 architect to deliver the first beta version in 2016

positions.title: Manager, R&D
positions.description:
Development manager on the vmWare vRealize product. My team focused on:

•  Prototype next generation of installers for Windows and Linux
•  Internationalization to supports Europeans and Chinese OS
•  Installers, we built a more user friendly and troubleshooting friendly installers in  .NET/C# and MSI of course.
•  Upgrade and migration
•  Test automation, Automated smoke test.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Acquired by VMware,
• Feature lead on the DynamicOps Cloud Automation Center (DCAC) product
I led small sub team of  developers and  testers to implement the following
• Virtual Machine disk reconfiguration
• Support of the Microsoft SCVMM by DCAC

VMware acquired DynamicOps in July 2012

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Product Lead
positions.description:
2009-2011 – Product lead of the ScerIS Electronic Form product
• Improved customer satisfaction by reducing the number of bugs and regression issues, by adopting extreme programming practice of TDD, exhaustive unit test coverage and web automation with selenium/web driver.
• Turn a legacy code based into a extendable and maintainable product. 

2006-2008 – Product lead of the ScerIS Document Archiving product
• Implemented complete logging of the all .NET web services, to better troubleshoot customer production issue on premise system.
• Migrate product from 32 bit to 64 bits OS
• Migrate product from .NET 2.0 to .NET 4.0 (230 000 lines of C++ and 380 000 lines of C#)
• Migrate product Visual Source Safe source control to Microsoft TFS, including build system
• Design and Implement new features as needed

As a product lead, I generally work with three developers and two QA persons on the different activities of the SDLC of the two products. My work experiences include mentoring, builds, releases and patches management, organizing design and code reviews and writing code, unit tests and integration tests. Assist the professional service and support team.

Windows server 2003/2008 64B, C# .NET 3.5/4.0, Win Form and ASP.NET, Microsoft SQL Server, TFS 2010, Powershell.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Roles:		Web Application Architect, Application Lead, QA Manager

•	Created from scratch the Professional Service Quality Team, to improve the quality of the developments deployed on existing customer production sites (2005/2006).
•	Automation team lead and architect. Designed and developed the automation tools needed to test the MetraTech Billing system (2001/2005). The different tools were used by the developers, QA and release engineer teams.
•	UI Team lead and architect for the MetraTech Customer Care, Operation web applications and the Export/Import utility (2000/2004). Designer of the MetraTech Web Application Framework (ASP.NET did not exist yet at the time), on which was based all the web applications of the company (2000/2003).

C++, VB, VBScript, COM, ASP, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Feature lead of the 'Longview 2000 Trade Order Management Application' Database Layer (OLEDB Provider, C++, COM, MS SQL Server and SYBASE).
•	Feature lead of a C++ source code generator producing an interface to the stored procedures.
•	Application lead of the Trade Import application. VB6 client server application using MS SQL Server or SYBASE. The application was a customizable rules engine validating trades before importing them into the database.

VB6, C++, MS SQL Server, SYBASE, Windows
